$comment: L2C-02-HOMEFMT: Home-tab text formatting contracts (computed-style on the first word's element). Ledger rows: formatting.align-*-ctrl-*, formatting.justified-ctrl-j, formatting.underline-ctrl-u, formatting.strikethrough-ctrl-5, formatting.subscript-ctrl, formatting.superscript-ctrl. Explicit selectors are required: the ledger wo.match values are camelCase (justifyLeft/strikeThrough) while tokens are lowercased, and the runner's [data-cmd=<token>] fallback would miss them.

justifyleft.note: ledger row: formatting.align-left-ctrl-l — on the default left-aligned document justifyLeft is a parity no-op: Chromium skips the style write when the block already computes text-align:start (its name for unset/left), so the honest post-click state is start, not a literal left

underline.note: ledger row: formatting.underline-ctrl-u — execCommand('underline') wraps the selection in <u>, which the runner's computed-style reader (closest b,i,u,span,p) reaches

strikethrough.note: ledger row: formatting.strikethrough-ctrl-5 — probe: execCommand('strikeThrough') wraps the selection in <strike>

superscript.note: ledger row: formatting.superscript-ctrl — probe: execCommand('superscript') wraps the selection in <sup>; scoped selector skips the hidden Script-options menuitem with the same data-cmd

subscript.note: ledger row: formatting.subscript-ctrl — probe: execCommand('subscript') wraps the selection in <sub>; scoped selector skips the hidden Script-options menuitem with the same data-cmd (first-match bug)
